name: Are wear and tear repairs tax deductible for homeowners or landlords in California?

mainEntity.name: Are wear and tear repairs tax deductible for homeowners or landlords in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homeowners, wear and tear repairs on your primary residence are generally not tax deductible. However, if you rent out a portion of your home or own rental properties, landlords in California can typically deduct ordinary and necessary expenses for repairs and maintenance, including those due to wear and tear. This helps maintain the property's condition for tenants. It is always advisable to consult with a tax professional to understand the specific implications for your individual situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wear and tear repairs are generally not tax deductible for primary homeowners, but landlords in California can usually deduct them as rental expenses.
